title: Hosanna Cabin & Retreat: Log Home near Nashville
description:
Welcome To Hosanna Cabin & Retreat!

Seated on beautiful private land,  your peaceful getaway awaits!  You'll feel like you're in Gatlinburg, but just minutes from Nashville! 

This spacious log home is perfect for families or large groups who would love to be a perfect distance from Nashville!

The space
1 King Bed
2 Queen Beds
1 Full Bed
1 Bunk Bed ( twin over full)

Guest access
You’ll have the whole property to yourself with stunning views! Enjoy the fire pit, long driveway, basketball hoop, and a peaceful time! 
Please do not park in Garage.

Other things to note
Late checkout available until 12:30pm upon request for a $75 fee.
